# Security Review — raffle-fun

**Scope:** 5 files, 2 contracts
**Method:** accounting-first review across 12 attack lenses
**Findings:** 0 High · 3 Medium · 2 Low · 7 Info

`raffle-fun` deploys one minimal ERC-1167 [`Raffle`](file:///Users/hishamel-husseini/.codex/visualizations/2026/10/21/01a15d64-4430-7440-b259-192acf9762b5/raffle-audit-r001/runtime/gemini-native-repairs/SIMAO/attempt-04/adjudication-work/packages/contracts/src/Raffle.sol#L30-L614) clone per raffle via [`RaffleFactory::createRaffle()`](file:///Users/hishamel-husseini/.codex/visualizations/2026/10/21/01a15d64-4430-7440-b259-192acf9762b5/raffle-audit-r001/runtime/gemini-native-repairs/SIMAO/attempt-04/adjudication-work/packages/contracts/src/RaffleFactory.sol#L97-L148), escrowing a single ERC-721 prize (`prizeToken`, `prizeTokenId`) from a sponsor and selling contiguous entry ranges (`[firstEntry, lastEntry]`) as ERC-721 tickets priced at a fixed `ENTRY_PRICE = 1_000_000` (1 USDC) per entry into `unsettledPot`. After `endTime`, a permissionless caller funds a native Chainlink VRF v2.5 request in [`Raffle::requestDraw()`](file:///Users/hishamel-husseini/.codex/visualizations/2026/10/21/01a15d64-4430-7440-b259-192acf9762b5/raffle-audit-r001/runtime/gemini-native-repairs/SIMAO/attempt-04/adjudication-work/packages/contracts/src/Raffle.sol#L240-L273), and [`Raffle::fulfillRandomWords()`](file:///Users/hishamel-husseini/.codex/visualizations/2026/10/21/01a15d64-4430-7440-b259-192acf9762b5/raffle-audit-r001/runtime/gemini-native-repairs/SIMAO/attempt-04/adjudication-work/packages/contracts/src/Raffle.sol#L509-L524) selects a winning entry in `1..totalEntries` and resolves the clone to `Status.NftWon` (`totalEntries >= reserveEntries`) or `Status.CashWon` (`totalEntries < reserveEntries`). In `Status.NftWon`, [`Raffle::_settleWinningTicket()`](file:///Users/hishamel-husseini/.codex/visualizations/2026/10/21/01a15d64-4430-7440-b259-192acf9762b5/raffle-audit-r001/runtime/gemini-native-repairs/SIMAO/attempt-04/adjudication-work/packages/contracts/src/Raffle.sol#L533-L558) splits `unsettledPot` 95% to `sponsorProceeds` and 5% to `protocolFees` while the winning ticket holder claims the escrowed NFT; in `Status.CashWon`, `unsettledPot` splits 80% to `winnerProceeds`, 15% to `sponsorProceeds`, and 5% to `protocolFees` while the sponsor reclaims the NFT via [`Raffle::releaseSponsorPrize()`](file:///Users/hishamel-husseini/.codex/visualizations/2026/10/21/01a15d64-4430-7440-b259-192acf9762b5/raffle-audit-r001/runtime/gemini-native-repairs/SIMAO/attempt-04/adjudication-work/packages/contracts/src/Raffle.sol#L395-L407). Because `ENTRY_PRICE = 1_000_000` is an exact multiple of `BPS = 10_000`, quote-token splits conserve USDC with zero rounding dust, and if the draw request or VRF callback misses its 2-day deadline (`Status.Refunding`), `remainingRefundLiability = unsettledPot` refunds every burned ticket at `1_000_000` USDC per entry with the `requestDraw()` caller absorbing the sunk native VRF fee.
